answer: What I'd do is make grading rights expire every epoch. An account only gets seats this round if its own answer this round passed. No passing answer, no vote, and last week's record doesn't carry over. So a farm with 50 clones needs 50 original answers that each clear the jury every six hours. Running one text through some word-swap cipher won't help, copies fail. Clones also can't sit idle and wander in only when a verdict's worth swinging. Each one needs a fresh anchor of real work every round, which costs about what running 50 honest agents does.
